inbound_message:
From: Rachel Oyelaran <rachel.oyelaran@mailbox.example>
To: Aerlink Customer Care <care@aerlink.example>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:22:40 +0100
Subject: AK307 - £900 and I am not negotiating

Booking AER-6H1Z7C.

Your flight AK307 to Madrid on Sunday 2 August was cancelled and I was pushed
onto a later one that got me in four and a half hours late. I missed a dinner
that I had flown out specifically for.

I want £900. That is what I have calculated the whole thing has cost me and I am
not interested in your standard amount or a voucher or an apology. I have been a
customer for seven years and I have had to complain three times in the last
twelve months, so you can hardly claim this is unusual.

To be very clear: £900, paid to the card I booked with, this week. If it is not
paid I will be going to the ombudsman and to my solicitor, and I will be posting
the entire correspondence publicly.

Rachel Oyelaran

decision.summary:
Escalated to a human (queue: GENERAL).
Summary: Rachel Oyelaran's flight AK307 was canceled, and she is entitled to £220 in compensation due to a significant delay and cause under Aerlink's control. Additionally, a hotel voucher for £180 will be issued for duty of care due to the cancellation.
Requested decision: Authorize a compensation payment of £220 to Rachel Oyelaran for the cancellation of her flight AK307 and any other related decisions regarding her duty of care.
Escalation ID: ESC-00008

result.note: S10.2: where this service returns a figure, that figure is the amount owed. It takes precedence over a figure derived by reading the policy text.

reasoning: S1.3: great-circle distance 1264 km, therefore Band A.
S3: operational record shows cause_code=TECHNICAL, which is within Aerlink's control (S3.3).
S5.1(c): arrival delay at final destination is 270 minutes, at or above the 3 hour threshold.
S5.3: Band A standard amount is GBP 220.00.
S5.4: passenger was re-routed but arrival delay 270 minutes is not below the Band A reduction threshold of 240 minutes, so no reduction applies.

duty_of_care.basis: S4.1: flight cancelled, care owed immediately.
duty_of_care.note: S4 care is owed regardless of cause, including extraordinary circumstances (S4.3).
